cohort: 55 exclusively breastfed infants aged 15-60 days with excessive fuss and crying, weighing at least 2500 grams and without genetic or clinical disorders, referred to a clinic in Iran.
finding: Kangaroo Mother Care significantly reduced the daily fuss and crying time in colicky infants from an average of 2.21 hours to 1.16 hours.
birth_weight: greater than or equal to 2500 grams
